safetyCommitments.title: Full Compliance
safetyCommitments.desc: Strict adherence to Indian Standards (IS), IE rules, and state electricity board safety protocols.

safetyCommitments.title: Rigorous Training
safetyCommitments.desc: Our technical team undergoes mandatory safety training for handling up to 33 kV equipment.

safetyCommitments.title: Zero compromise
safetyCommitments.desc: Ensuring safe isolation, earthing, discharge checks, and proper PPE before contact.

qualityCommitments.title: Process Excellence
qualityCommitments.desc: Applying systematic testing procedures (dielectric, injection) before breaker charging.

qualityCommitments.title: Continuous Improvement

qualityCommitments.title: Reliability

productRanges.title: MV Switchgear

productRanges.title: Numerical Relays

productRanges.title: Refurbished Relays

services.title: VCB Servicing
services.desc: Spring-charge, closing, tripping & interlock mechanisms, control-circuit healthiness, limb & pole alignment and vacuum-interrupter inspection.

services.title: VCB Overhauling
services.desc: Full mechanism overhaul, lubrication of moving parts, snatch-gap measurement and drive-shaft & insulator checks — tested before charging.

services.title: 33 kV Panel Servicing
services.desc: Dismantling & re-insulation of bus spouts, support insulators, CTs & PTs with heat-shrink sleeving; busbar-chamber cleaning and enamel painting.

services.title: Epoxy Housing Re-insulation
services.desc: Dismantling epoxy housing assemblies, cleaning sulphur & moisture, re-insulating and refixing to the VCB track.

services.title: GIS Gas & Interlock Service
services.desc: Gas-level checking & filling, leakage rectification, interlock-circuit inspection and auxiliary-switch alignment on GIS chambers.

services.title: Testing & Emergency Support
services.desc: Pre-charging breaker testing under client supervision, rapid on-site fault attendance and just-in-time supply of spares.
